summary: Bash CLI for the Clockodo API

global_flags.name: --json
global_flags.description: Emit exactly one JSON envelope on stdout and nothing on stderr. Interactive pickers are disabled; missing input fails with code missing_argument.

global_flags.name: --curl
global_flags.description: Print the curl command of the first request instead of sending it, then exit 0. Contains the API key in clear text. Wins over --json and --dry-run.

global_flags.name: --dry-run
global_flags.description: Report write requests (POST, DELETE) instead of sending them, then exit 0. Read requests such as lookups still run. Shows no credentials.

global_flags.name: --help
global_flags.description: Print the text help of the group (also -h). Wins over --json.

environment.name: CLOCKODO_ENV_FILE
environment.description: Env file to read instead of the repo .env.

environment.name: CLOCKODO_READ_ONLY
environment.description: 1 = refuse every write request (error code read_only). --dry-run still works.

environment.name: DEBUG
environment.description: 1 = dump requests and responses to stderr (ignored with --json).

error_codes.configuration_error: CLOCKODO_API_USER / CLOCKODO_API_KEY missing or CLOCKODO_ENV_FILE not found; run clockodo doctor.
error_codes.http_<status>: The API answered with HTTP >= 400; see error.http_status and error.body.
error_codes.internal_error: Missing tool (curl, jq) or a broken installation.
error_codes.invalid_argument: An argument or option has an invalid value.
error_codes.invalid_response: The API answered with a success status but no valid JSON.
error_codes.missing_argument: A required argument is missing (also: an interactive picker would be needed).
error_codes.network_error: No HTTP response at all (DNS, connection, timeout).
error_codes.read_only: A write request was refused because CLOCKODO_READ_ONLY=1.

describe.data: Without arguments: this root contract plus the list of groups. With a group: the group contract. With group and action: the action contract.

doctor.summary: Check tools, configuration and API access.
doctor.data: {healthy: bool, checks: [{name, status: ok|warn|fail|skip, message}]}. Exit code 1 when healthy is false.

upgrade.summary: Fast-forward the git checkout to origin/main.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Fetch only and report whether an update is available.

version.summary: Show the local and the published CLI version.
version.requests: GET of the entry script on GitHub (no credentials)
